live_active_learning.source: KYRO GP over the completed 16-pt CGYRO A1e map
live_active_learning.acquisition: max GP posterior std (uncertainty sampling), min-separation filtered
live_active_learning.verdict: Proposes the next CGYRO run at a/L_T=2.225, shear=0.58 (highest GP uncertainty). Leave-one-out: GP posterior-std vs actual error correlation = -0.283 — weak on this small map. A real experimental-design tool: spend ~2.9 GPU-h/point where it matters.

caveat: 16 training points is small — acquisition is directional guidance, not a guarantee
